title: Fix profile page skeleton state and post creation failure

requirements.text: Fix the ProfilePage so it correctly fetches and displays the authenticated user's real data (avatar, display name, bio, follower/following counts, and posts grid) instead of remaining stuck in the skeleton/loading placeholder state indefinitely.

quotes: Profile page is stuck in a skeleton/loading (blueprint) state — showing dark placeholder shapes instead of actual user data like avatar, name, and posts

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /profile displays the logged-in user's avatar, display name, and bio after data loads
Follower and following counts are shown with real values
The user's posts appear in the grid below the profile header
Skeleton placeholders are only shown during the initial data fetch, not indefinitely
If the user has no profile yet, a prompt to create one is displayed instead of an endless skeleton

requirements.text: Fix the backend query/mutation wiring in ProfilePage so the useGetMyProfile (or equivalent) hook properly resolves — ensure the actor is initialized before the query runs, error states are handled gracefully, and the profile data is correctly mapped from the backend response variant to the UI state.

quotes: it just shown blueprint not the profile

acceptanceCriteria: The profile query does not fire before the actor is ready
A backend #ok variant response is correctly unwrapped and applied to the UI
A backend #err variant response shows an appropriate error message rather than a permanent skeleton
Refreshing the profile page re-fetches and renders data correctly

requirements.text: Fix the CreatePostPage so that submitting a post (text, image, or video) succeeds instead of showing 'Failed to create post. Please try again.' Diagnose and repair the useCreatePost mutation: ensure media blobs are correctly encoded and passed to the backend, the actor call parameters match the backend's expected argument types, and success/error states are handled properly.

quotes: Failed to create post. Please try again
when click share it show that failed to post

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a text-only post succeeds and the new post appears in the feed
Submitting a post with an image file succeeds and the image is displayed on the post card
Submitting a post with a video file succeeds and the video is playable on the post card
On success, the user is navigated away from CreatePostPage (e.g., back to feed or profile)
On a genuine backend error, a descriptive error message is shown and the user can retry
The 'Failed to create post' error no longer appears for valid submissions

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All Motoko logic must remain in a single actor in backend/main.mo
nonGoals: Adding new post types or media formats beyond what already exists
Adding new profile fields not already in the backend schema
